notes.title: Patch 1.1.1
notes.content:
[p]This patch primarily brings additional stability, fixes and small improvements. This also marks the final update for Locomoto, or the "last stop" if you will. We’ve done our best these last few months to fix the biggest issues you have reported, and this last patch will hopefully get most of it sorted.  Thank you to all our wonderful players, new and old, who joined us on this beautiful journey. Your love and support has meant the world to us, and we're happy we got to make this game for you![/p][p]Stay awesome, and we’ll see you along the rails

Love,
The Green Tile Digital development team
[/p][h2]Changes[/h2][list][*][p] \[Saving] Made the ending cutscene not run autosave on entry.[/p][/*][/list][h2]Improvements[/h2][list][*][p] \[Items] Onions now have a size on grids.[/p][/*][*][p] \[Quests] Changed requirement and reward for white wood donation in Orchard Lusk.[/p][/*][*][p] \[Rendering] Activated Unity Render Graph, improving performance.[/p][/*][*][p] \[Rendering] Added debug command to disable depth prepass if it is causing issues. 
[i]SetDepthPrepassActive(false)[/i][/p][/*][*][p] \[Rendering] Adjusted some materials to use the same shader variant, reducing batch count.[/p][/*][*][p] \[Rendering] Fixed decals not rendering on OpenGL.[/p][/*][*][p] \[Rendering] Made depth prepass handle pixel culling, improving performance.[/p][/*][*][p] \[Rendering] Optimized rendering by improving batching of opaque materials. [/p][/*][*][p] \[Rendering] Reduced overdraw risk by removing unseen parts of skybox meshes. [/p][/*][*][p] \[Stations] Adjusted Miner's Roost nav graph.[/p][/*][*][p] \[Stations] Cleaned stations by removing colliders outside the playable area.[/p][/*][*][p] \[Stations] Removed meshes that were never visible in the environment.[/p][/*][/list][h2]Bugfixes[/h2][list][*][p] \[Clothing] Fixed an issue with some dresses overlapping with worn shirts/pants instead of hiding them.[/p][/*][*][p] \[Customization] Fixed the wallpaper set-up in the large fancy passenger wagon.[/p][/*][*][p] \[Deliveries] Fixed Trough and Newgale parcels.[/p][/*][*][p] \[Items] Changed the stack layer height for black and purple fabric, it's now the same as the other fabrics.[/p][/*][*][p] \[Items] Collider fix for Painting_Rec.[/p][/*][*][p] \[Quests] Auto upgrader for fixing the white wood flooring reward and activating subsequent delivery spots.[/p][/*][*][p] \[Quests] Re-enabled quest regression protection for quest entries.[/p][/*][*][p] \[Rendering] Fixed a depth issue in the grass terrain shader that was causing broken visuals near the camera.[/p][/*][*][p] \[Rendering] Fixed shadows from trees cutting out when the player is close.[/p][/*][*][p] \[Spawning] Made SubgridHolder have proper handling for getting voided out while spawning items.[/p][/*][*][p] \[Wagons] Ceiling lamp quirks ironed out.[/p][/*][*][p] \[Wagons] Door in fancy compartment now visible and door in small standard swapped to no handle.

notes.title: The Floors & Clothes Update 👗✨
notes.content:
[h2]Welcome The Floors & Clothes Update on board! 🧱👗[/h2][p]We're stoked to announce that Locomoto's first ever Content Update is out now![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45339008/5aaf78a6b3a6b9f4d3fc14462173e200e91400b9.png"][/img][/p][h2]What's new?[/h2][list][*][p][b]More character creator options[/b], including tails, hairstyles and brand new reptile features, just to name a few![/p][/*][*][p][b]More clothes and accessories[/b] to dress your dapper conductor with new shoes, hats, dresses and more![/p][/*][*][p][b]Customizable flooring![/b] You will now be able to change the floor in your train the way you can with paint and wallpapers![/p][/*][*][p][b]Carpets,[/b] so you can make your train extra homey![/p][/*][*][p]Make sure to visit Finley in Barrenpyre to start unlocking the new items![/p][/*][/list][p]We've also been fixing some smaller issues like the mood of the Sprites, as well as given the mail parcels a unique look for each station so that they're easier to tell apart. On top of this we've of course kept working on the bugs you report! [/p][p][/p][h2]Patch Notes 1.1.0
 [/h2][h3]Added Content[/h3][list][*][p]\[Clothing] 37 new clothing items added, including dresses and caps.  [/p][/*][*][p]\[Floors] 17 floors + a storage item added.[/p][/*][*][p]\[Carpets] 24 carpets + a storage item added.  [/p][/*][*][p]\[Character Customisation] 25 new character customisation features added, including reptile features.  [/p][/*][*][p]\[Decorations] 13 decoration items added.  [/p][/*][/list][h3]Improvements[/h3][list][*][p]Multiple stability and performance improvements on lower-end hardware.  [/p][/*][*][p]Softlock safety: If a player gets stuck, saving and restarting will now place them in a safe location.   [/p][/*][*][p]Nora’s Vaccination Pamphlets and the Written Exams now have specific textures.  [/p][/*][*][p]Some assets having no material now have assigned materials.  [/p][/*][*][p]Added some signposts to the stations in Hearth’s Peak.  [/p][/*][*][p][spoiler]Waterproofing[/spoiler] is now visible on the locomotive once Oceanward objective [spoiler]"Deliver the Waterproof Covers to McGruff"[/spoiler] is completed. [/p][/*][*][p]Academia and Fancy Wardrobes now fit a 2x1 gridspace.  [/p][/*][*][p]Parcels now have unique visuals depending on their destination.   [/p][/*][*][p]Updated moods for Sprites, they now have a happy state!  [/p][/*][*][p]Lizzie’s donation box is a bit bigger.  [/p][/*][*][p]The inside visuals of the Locomotive are now upgraded with the outside.  [/p][/*][*][p]Tweaked the visuals when holding certain lamps.  [/p][/*][*][p]Added visual update to planting Ned’s seeds/sprouts.  [/p][/*][/list][h3]Bugfixes[/h3][list][*][p]\[FX] The Rhubarb Pie Maker plays animation correctly.[/p][/*][*][p]\[Grids] Fixed some floating grids in wagons and tweaked wall grids. (If some of your items are missing you should be able to retrieve them from the lost and found box!)[/p][/*][*][p]\[Grids] Tweaked placement of grids on furniture. (If some of your items are missing you should be able to retrieve them from the lost and found box!)[/p][/*][*][p]\[Map] Fixed some quest indicators sometimes not showing up on the map.[/p][/*][*][p]\[Quests] Added more furniture from the Standard Set that are viable to show Rosalind during Crafty Teachings quest.[/p][/*][*][p]\[Quests] Asking Louise for flower seeds no longer blocks her dialogue at Rainfall's Watch during The Other Side quest.[/p][/*][*][p]\[Quests] Fixed fade to black scenes in Tunnel to You, Keepsakes and A Thousand Degrees quests. [/p][/*][*][p]\[Quests] Philosophy books are not counted twice if placed in the Language box anymore in Time for Class-ification quest.[/p][/*][*][p]\[Quests] Updated the quest handling system. Newly acquired quests *should* no longer randomly regress to a previous state.[/p][/*][*][p]\[Quests] You can no longer lock yourself out of the Sunken Treasure Quest by declining it twice.  [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Finally, a huge thank you to all you Conductors, your support and feedback mean the world to us! [/p][p][/p][p]Stay cool, and we'll see you again soon along the rails! ♡[/p][p][i]The Green Tile Team[/i][/p]

notes.title: Patch 1.0.5
notes.content:
[h3]Hello Conductors![/h3]

Thank you all for staying patient as we work to improve the game by resolving bugs, adding a few quality of life fixes, and other new things, like some more clothing rewards for your conductor!

We’re approaching summer in Sweden and we’re also closing in on our first console release which means updates will be a bit less frequent. We’ll still be active on [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2328650/discussions/]Steam[/url] and [url=https://discord.gg/VVZcztRe8U]Discord[/url] so if you ever have any questions or issues you need help with, that’s where you’ll find us. 

[i]See you again soon conductors![/i]

[h1]Patch 1.0.5[/h1]

[h2]Changes[/h2][list]
[*] [Clothing] More clothing items added as in-scene rewards.
[*] [Items] Added grids to furniture that was missing them.[/list]
[h2]Improvements[/h2][list]
[*] [Achievements] Achievement incremental progress display for the achievements that have partial progress.
[*] [Animations] Added emotes to most conversations, making things more lively.
[*] [Interactions] Benches are now sit-able!
[*] [Placement grid] Made grids show which spaces are occupied and which ones are free.
[*] [Wagon Miniatures] Updated the visuals for the wagon miniatures so that they all have unique visuals![/list]
[h2]Bugfixes[/h2][list]
[*] [Saves] Fixed all remaining known broken quest states in existing save files.
[*] [Audio] Fixed Pyresprite sounds lingering after they're gone.
[*] [Customization] Fixed storage wagon paint resetting inside when painting outside and vice versa.
[*] [Items] Loose items in wagons (garbage dropped by passengers, resources from breaking furniture, the ceiling lamps) now save their local position. Loading a wagon saved before 1.0.5 now throws all non-garbage items into lost and found and destroys the garbage. This should fix a lot of wonky ceiling lamps.
[*] [UI] “Credits” button can now be accessed when using a controller.
[*] [UI] Fixed the issue where the rotate button was displaying the wrong binding.
[*] [Stations] Begonia Fields train left and right position tweak.[/list]
[h2]Known bugs[/h2] [list]
[*] [Animation] The [spoiler]air collecting[/spoiler] animation is missing for [spoiler]Loretta's location[/spoiler] during [spoiler]“Something in the Air”.[/spoiler]
[*] [Items] Luggage (and sometimes other items) can spawn on rails.[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.0.4
notes.content:
[h3]Hello Conductors! 🚂[/h3]

[b]We're back with a BUNCH of bugfixes! [/b]

We know some of you have experienced some progress blocking bugs, and we're terribly sorry you've been stuck. We wanted to make sure the fixes helps both new and old players as well as don't trigger any new bugs, which is why it's taken some extra time to get this patch out. We're so thankful for all your reports and for your patience, you guys are amazing.  

All known game progression blockers should be fixed here, and we've also implemented fixes for most of the saves that have run into them already. We still have a few left we've already started working on, so more fixes are coming soon! 

If you're still having issues or if you run into a new bug, check out some helpful tips in [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2328650/discussions/1/651441305622218643/]this discussion thread[/url] or [url=https://discord.gg/VVZcztRe8U]join our Discord[/url] for quick bug reporting and help from our devs ⭐

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45339008/44c34c534399180a9027670fe9665af9b82c23b6.png[/img]

[h1]Patch 1.0.4[/h1]

[h2]Changes[/h2][list]
[*] [Quests] Made changes to the Quests backend to make sure NPCs behave more reasonably.[/list]
[h2]QOL[/h2][list]
[*][Art] There will now be a newspaper on the table at [spoiler]Fendrix Farms[/spoiler] after the [spoiler]Half-full, Half-empty[/spoiler] quest
[*][Camera] Players are now able to lower the camera a little bit more in the train so that you can now see the ceiling.  
[*][Crafting] Added blueprints for decorations so you can craft them if they have been broken with the hammer.
[*][Map] Added the tokens view to the map menu view. The scroll view now always starts from the top when showing the menu view.
[*][Map] Map now focuses on the station the Player is at whenever it's opened.
[*][Map] Map now shows extra stations, such as [spoiler]McGruff’s Workshop, Fields, Beach, Mines in Barrenpyre[/spoiler] and [spoiler]Rainfall’s Watch in Hearth’s Peak[/spoiler].
[*][Quests] Entry in [spoiler]Anniversary[/spoiler] quest now tells [spoiler]Katja and Rosalind[/spoiler] that they should want to board the train.
[*][Resources] Resource balancing! Added Aged Copper, Black marble, Aluminium & Gold to the token machines in [spoiler]Hearth's Peak[/spoiler]. Added Rosewood to [spoiler]Rosalind's Carpentry and Peteny.[/spoiler]
[*][Stations] Added a new critter ([spoiler]Leafles[/spoiler]) to [spoiler]Pickaxe Point[/spoiler] station. 
[*][Stations] Camera colliders around Katzengold station should now be less intrusive.
[*][Stations] Collision tweaks and fixes all around the game.
[*][Text] Added missing descriptions for a few craftable items: [spoiler](Rustic Floor Shelf, Raver Doll, Scare Slug, Rock Tower, Cute Flower Pot and Flower Pot)[/spoiler].
[*][Token Machines] Token machines on stations now show which resources they give out on the sign.
[*][UI] Credits are now accessible from the main menu.
[*][UI] Some fonts scale up when using a SteamDeck.
[*] Various other quality of life changes.[/list]
[h2]Bugfixes[/h2][list]
[*][Achievements] The Railway Enthusiast achievement now counts 14 wagons, including the wagons that the player starts with, to properly reflect the total amount of wagons that’s been collected.
[*][Art] The well in [spoiler]Orchard and Lusk[/spoiler] no longer changes appearance and location during [spoiler]Water in the Well[/spoiler] quest.
[*][Clothing] Players now get the correct hat for the red formal conductors outfit
[*][Items] Made it impossible to give away player owned items to delivery points.
[*][Map] The planned map route should now not be cleared anymore if the Player moves from a sub area in a station.
[*][NPC] Added more conditions to Lizzie, so that she'll only give seeds to Where the grass is greener, when you're in Marigold and she's not on the train.
[*][NPC] [spoiler]Bastion[/spoiler] is no longer leaving for the platform until Player has talked to him, [spoiler]Nora and Timothy[/spoiler] during the [spoiler]Heating Up[/spoiler] quest.
[*][NPC] Bastion will now accept both types of shelves from the [spoiler]Rustic furniture set[/spoiler] during [spoiler]Learning the Trade[/spoiler].
[*][NPC] Liam now goes to the station when he wants to travel during the Doctor's Visit quest.
[*][NPC] Liam will now not [spoiler]stalk the player[/spoiler] after [spoiler]the main quest line is done[/spoiler] anymore.
[*][NPC] Loretta and McGruff will spawn in [spoiler]Vaster Reach[/spoiler] even if you forget them during the first quest entry of [spoiler]Last train home.[/spoiler]
[*][Performance] Fixed so performance doesn’t drop in dialogue anymore.
[*][Quests] Added a couple fixes for [spoiler]Master of the Craft[/spoiler], making Horst want to talk about the [spoiler]exam[/spoiler] in the first place, and hopefully fixing the [spoiler]lost exam paper[/spoiler] dialogue issue.
[*][Quests] [spoiler]“Board Loretta”[/spoiler] and [spoiler]“board McGruff”[/spoiler] entries now gets checked as done even if you [spoiler]drive to Vaster Reach without boarding them[/spoiler] during the [spoiler]Oceanward[/spoiler] quest.
[*][Quests] During the [spoiler]Light In The Tunnel[/spoiler] quest there were [spoiler]two lamp posts that were shining bright in Northend View[/spoiler]. Now there should only be [spoiler]one bright light there instead[/spoiler].
[*][Quests] Ensure you can talk to [spoiler]Louise[/spoiler] and the others at the end of [spoiler]Beneath Earth and Dust without the volcanic rock[/spoiler], in case people have given the [spoiler]volcanic rock to the sprite already.[/spoiler]
[*][Quests] Fixed a blocking issue where if Player brought the [spoiler]paint brush[/spoiler] onto the train it was destroyed. It will now respawn properly instead.
[*][Quests] Fixed a bug where Horst didn’t want to talk to you after [spoiler]finishing the exam[/spoiler] during the [spoiler]Master Of The Craft[/spoiler] quest.
[*][Quests] Fixed a bug where McGruff didn’t accept any [spoiler]toy wagons[/spoiler] after the main questline was completed for the [spoiler]Railway Enthusiast[/spoiler] quest. 
[*][Quests] Fixed so [spoiler]Hestia and Taisce[/spoiler] can't start their second quests unless they're in [spoiler]Orchard and Lusk.[/spoiler]
[*][Quests] Fixed so quests with reverted quest entries can be completed (for some players).
[*][Quests] Fixed The Collector quest, Railway Enthusiast achievement and Sunken Treasure quest. 
[*][Quests] [spoiler]Loretta[/spoiler] will only be in [spoiler]Barrenpyre Square[/spoiler] during the parts she's needed in the [spoiler]Cleaning Day[/spoiler] quest and then go back to her home.
[*][Quests] Made [spoiler]Bountiful Blessings[/spoiler] easier to trigger.
[*][Quests] Made sure the [spoiler]flower vase in Anniversary[/spoiler] doesn’t disappear if you leave the station.
[*][Quests] Made it clearer that the Player needs to [spoiler]bring McGruff and Loretta on the train[/spoiler] to [spoiler]Vaster Reach[/spoiler] during the [spoiler] Oceanward and Last Train Home[/spoiler] quest.
[*][Quests] [spoiler]Master of the craft[/spoiler] can now be completed on old broken saves.
[*][Quests] Players are now able to read the letter on the bench in [spoiler]Miner’s Roost during the Little Lights quest[/spoiler].
[*][Quest] Players can’t lock themselves out of [spoiler]Something To Do[/spoiler] anymore. 
[*][Quests] Pyre Sprites will now properly disappear from your train after the quest [spoiler]Last Train Home[/spoiler] is done.
[*][Quest] [spoiler]The Collector[/spoiler] can be completed even if all [spoiler]9 wagons[/spoiler] were turned in before the requirement changed from [spoiler]12 to 9.[/spoiler]
[*][Quests] The quest entry for The Collector quest does now reflect the amount of [spoiler]wagons[/spoiler] you must collect to complete it, which is [spoiler]9 wagons[/spoiler].
[*][Quests] The quest [spoiler]"Restoring Barrenpyre"[/spoiler] will not get automatically pinned.
[*][Quests] Timothy will now only do the [spoiler]Tour de Trough[/spoiler] while he’s in [spoiler]Trough[/spoiler].
[*][Quests] Tintin's quest [spoiler]A Light in the Tunnel[/spoiler] is now locked until [spoiler]The One Year Collapse[/spoiler] is completed, to minimise confusion about the main quest line progression.
[*][Quest] [spoiler]Tunnel to You[/spoiler] now requires [spoiler]3 apples (like the quest entry states) to complete the quest entry, and not only 2.[/spoiler] 
[*] [Quest] [spoiler]Where the Grass is Greener[/spoiler] can now be completed on all saves after [spoiler]talking to Aya.[/spoiler]
[*][Quests] [spoiler]Where the Grass is Greener[/spoiler] now completes on old saves as well.
[*][Rewards] [spoiler]Black diamond wallpaper[/spoiler] in [spoiler]Begonia Fields[/spoiler] now gives out the correct reward.
[*][Stations] Mining resources no longer spawn in the middle of the rock or on top of each other.
[*][Stations] Moved mining resources in Barrenpyre Mines area so their resources don't spawn under the ash.
[*][Stations] The visual items that were blocking the rails for the train when leaving [spoiler]Newgale station[/spoiler] will now despawn after repairing the rail between [spoiler]Newgale and Cinderdoor stations[/spoiler].
[*][Stations] Treasure chests don’t look open even though they’re locked anymore.
[*][Stations] Wallpaper found at Barrenpyre Beach no longer floats in the air.
[*][Stations] You should now not be able to get stuck in the rocks in Katzengold.
[*][Train] Locomotive paint and wallpaper won’t reset to previous color when loading a save.
[*][Train] Pie plates can now be placed on foldable tables.
[*][Train] Standard seats won’t revert back to default color scheme if the player exits the workshop after uncoupling that wagon.
[*] Various text and sound fixes.
[*] Various other bugfixes.[/list]
[h2]Known bugs[/h2] [list]
[*] [Items] Luggage can spawn on rails.
[*] [Items] The mop given out during [spoiler]Cleaning Day[/spoiler] can’t be taken to other areas of the station.
[*] [Tools] If the player has lost their mop by [spoiler]giving it away during Cleaning Day[/spoiler], run the GiveRewards(“GrantMop”) lua command to get it back.[/list]
[b]Have an amazing time in Locomoto! 🌸[/b]
[i]The Green Tile Devs[/i]

notes.title: Patch 1.0.3
notes.content:
[h3]Hello Conductors![/h3]

Hope you're all doing well. 
 
We,  The Green Tile devs, are heading off for a long weekend rest, but just before that we have some fixes to make things better overall, specifically existing quest bugs. 
 
We are  looking into an overhaul of some of the quest handling to make sure that NPCs can't get stuck doing the wrong things, but that won't be in until the next patch. 
 
If you get stuck due to quest issues over the weekend, our [url=https://discord.gg/VVZcztRe8U]Discord server[/url] and a our pinned post in our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2328650/discussions/1/651441305622218643/]Steam Discussions[/url] has some helpful solutions to this problem.
 
Have a great time in Locomoto and enjoy your Easter if you celebrate it!

[h2]Patch Notes 1.0.3[/h2]

[h2]Features[/h2]
[list]
[*] [Train] Engine pressure now increases while in the red zone. This eventually leads to the engine having to automatically release steam, lowering the pressure into the blue zone and spawning puddles.
[/list]
[h2]Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] [Animations] Added even more liveliness animations to NPCs.
[*] [Map] Clouds now animate when unlocking [spoiler]Hearth's Peak and Cerulean Sea.[/spoiler]
[*] [Map] Quests that mention extra areas are now showing on the map under their station.
[*] [Map] Station buttons turn yellow if the station has been stamped.
[*] [Saves] Loading a broken save file will now kick you back to the main menu and tag the save file as broken. This will make you load the next newest save file (usually an auto save) if you try loading the same save again.
[*] [UI] Added the indicator for high pressure.
[*] [UI] Fixed the buggy animations for Delivery Points, and added a delay for the map stamper popups.
[*] [UI] Made the icon for friendship quests bigger.
[*] [UI] New icons for map filters.
[/list]

[h2]Bugfixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] [Achievements] Auto give out the intro achievement on loading a game if the [spoiler]Housewarming[/spoiler] quest is done.
[*] [Achievements] Fixed issue with receiving the Globetrotter achievement.
[*] [Art] Fixed materials on mountains in the Main Menu.
[*] [Art] Small fix with the pressure indicator not showing up when loading a save.
[*] [Dialogue] Beatrice now calls player by name instead of "Player" in the one instance she did not.
[*] [Dialogue] Fixed syntax error in Jamar dialogue, code should no longer be visible.
[*] [Dialogue] [spoiler]Timothy[/spoiler] no longer introduces himself as if he and Player are in Trough during [spoiler]the auction.[/spoiler]
[*] [Items] Resized some mirrors to fit better on the wall.
[*] [Localization] Chinese localization fix for cozy lamp and [spoiler]"the west of Miner's Roost"[/spoiler]
[*] [Localization] Fixed a localization issue for the seat indicator.
[*] [Localization] Fixed syntax error in French localisation of quest New Heights, french quest entry now displays the amount of materials you've gathered.
[*] [Localization] Localized hover info on more delivery points.
[*] [Map] Fixed the issue with the highlighted rail not updating properly after closing the map.
[*] [Map] [spoiler]Heart’s Peak[/spoiler] rails should now take the shortest available route.
[*] [Map] Updated the size of the icons in the map. Adjusted the layout of the icons to not overlap when switching filters.
[*] [NPC] Added quest destination priority based on quest type. Should make NPCs more likely to be where they're supposed to be.
[*] [NPC] Passengers used to sometimes fail to unseat.
[*] [Particles] Breaking particles now have correct sizing.
[*] [Quests] Added auto fixing for [spoiler]Where the Grass is Greener, and part 3 of Something in the Air.[/spoiler]
[*] [Quests] [spoiler]Advertisement Adventures[/spoiler] now has to be completed in order to do [spoiler]Slippery Business[/spoiler].
[*] [Quests] Fixed broken Tonya interaction where she refused to [spoiler]acknowledge any other gem but the correct one during The Most Precious Thing.[/spoiler]
[*] [Quests] Fixed so Jamar will talk about [spoiler]Beth's book in Digging into the Past[/spoiler] quest even if Beth isn't following Player. (This may result in odd dialogue)
[*] [Quests] Fixed so Louise will accept [spoiler]the map in Spelunking quest[/spoiler], even if she's not in Miner's Roost.
[*] [Quests] Fixed so Tintin will accept his fixed helmet, even if Player isn't in Pickaxe Point
[*] [Quests] Fixed quest travel destinations. Loaded quests had bad sorting, NPCs sometimes tried taking the train to the current location.
[*] [Quests] [spoiler]Loretta[/spoiler] no longer starts the quest [spoiler]Fishing for Something[/spoiler] unless [spoiler]she's at Barrenpyre beach.[/spoiler]
[*] [Quests] Mud will be gone after [spoiler]completing Heating up by draining the mud bath[/spoiler] even when reloading the save.
[*] [Quests] [spoiler]Rua[/spoiler] no longer gives you the quest [spoiler]Something to Do[/spoiler] unless [spoiler]he's in Trough.[/spoiler]
[*] [Quests] The barrel in [spoiler]Slippery Business in Trough[/spoiler] is now visible before [spoiler]you repair it[/spoiler].
[*] [Quests] [spoiler]Volcanic Rock[/spoiler] is now properly given out when [spoiler]fishing in Trough during Heating Up[/spoiler].
[*] [Rewards] Breaking items don’t give out blueprints that are not craftable.
[*] [Rewards] The [spoiler]Yellow Daisy Wallpaper Reward in Hammerweld Station[/spoiler] can now be picked up.
[*] [Saves] Being in conversation now blocks saving, and loading another save ends any active conversations.
[*] [Saves] Made Something in the Air, Nora's Hope, and New Heights have some fixes for already broken saves.
[*] [Saves] New Heights delivery point shouldn’t revert anymore.
[*] [Stations] Added Evergreen Cross as a recycling station on the map.
[*] [Stations] Added Northend View as a recycling station on the map.
[*] [Stations] Dirt pile inside [spoiler]Barrenpyre Volcano[/spoiler] now gives out a reward.
[*] [Stations] Fixed Devon accidentally hanging out inside colliders.
[*] [Stations] Fixed fences and [spoiler]endgame player house extension[/spoiler] position.
[*] [Stations] Made Jamar's tools in Spiegelbreeze station owned and owned by him.
[*] [Stations] McGruff's new house added to Vaster Reach!
[*] [Stations] Pickaxe that spawns in [spoiler]Trough during Heating Up[/spoiler] is now owned by [spoiler]Bastion[/spoiler]. 
[*] [Steamworks] Disabled unused Steam interfaces, possibly fixing Steam Initialization failures for users with older Steam clients.
[*] [Train] Increased size of ceiling lamp interaction.
[*] [Train] Made the fade when going into or out from the train not get paused in the pause menu.
[*] [Train life] Coffee machine does the same thing as other 2 service machines when deploying a snack.
[*] [UI] Added the name "Delivery" to Bastion's Box.
[*] [UI] Fixed issues in the NPC tab where the text was behind the NPC images.
[*] [UI] Fixed the issue where changing slider values in the Options Menu would lose controller navigation.
[*] [UI] Made the popup only show craftable blueprints.
[/list]

[h2]Known bugs[/h2] 
[list]
[*] [Items] Fancy conductors hat has wrong visuals.
[*] [Items] Luggage can spawn on rails.
[*] [Items] The mop given out during [spoiler]Cleaning Day[/spoiler] can’t be taken to other areas of the station.
[*] [NPC] Liam stalks the player post game and wants to be boarded at every station. He also doesn’t have a travel destination.
[*] [NPC] NPCs can’t walk through the front of the dingy wagon. (visual bug)
[*] [Quests] Quest entries sometimes reset to an uncompleted state after having already been completed.
[*] [Stations] Treasure chests can look open even though they’re locked.
[*] [Train] Locomotive paint and wallpaper can be reset when loading a save.
[*] [Quests] Some quests can’t be completed if the relevant NPC is in the wrong location.
[*] [Train] Standard seats revert back to default color scheme if the player exits the workshop after uncoupling that wagon.
[/list]

Have a nice weekend everyone!
/EmeraldPawn

notes.title: Patch 1.0.2
notes.content:
Us at Green Tile Digital are loving your responses and engagement around Locomoto, and here we have a whole bundle of bugfixes and improvements that we gathered from things you've had issues with. Also, we found that fish weren't respawning properly, making fishing a hassle. We are happy to announce that Fishing is back!

[h2]Features[/h2]

[*] [Options menu] Added vertical FOV setting.
[*] [Options menu] Added VSync and frame limiter settings.

[h2]Improvements[/h2]
[list]

[*] [Items] Broken handlebar bell is usable.
[*] [Items] Updated the item icon for the rubbish bag.
[*] [Interactions] Added inspectable interaction to treasure chests.
[*] [Interactions] Peteny: Made bike draisine interaction a bit more clear.
[*] [Map view] Map camera can be moved around with the regular move keys (WASD in QWERTY keyboards).
[*] [NPCs] Added more life to NPCs at most stations with passive interactions that they can do.
[*] [NPC info UI] Made NPC sprites an equal quality level, adjusting outliers.
[*] [Options menu] Adjusted the visuals of the slider buttons.
[*] [Player menu] Added a paper edge effect in the Player Menu for ultrawide screens.
[*] [Quests] You now get to know who [spoiler]Sierra[/spoiler] is during [spoiler]Nora's Hope[/spoiler], making it easier to find them.
[*] [Stations] Changed the camera shots in Peteny when arriving and departing to make it more clear that there is another side of the station.
[*] [Stations] Made the stone fences less blocking for the camera.

[/list]
[h2]Bugfixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] [Areas] Fixed missing colliders in Orchard and Lusk, Player can no longer fall into and get stuck in the river.
[*] [Art] Fixed texture for Aya's coat (no more blue lines on the purple fur).
[*] [Crafting] Fixed it so crafting variations should work as intended now
[*] [Dialogue] Made Bastion wanting to talk about the same thing multiple times not cause softlocks.
[*] [Interactions] Fixed fishing interactions not working everywhere, and made them respawnable.
[*] [Interactions] Made static seats work the same as seat items, fixing the weird sitting directions and lack of effects.
[*] [Interactions] Removed broken inspection on the crane.
[*] [Items] Fixed standard hat rack not fitting on grids properly.
[*] [Map] The giant map pointer can't appear in the train anymore.
[*] [NPCs] Made sure Erin is sent back home after reading the letter.
[*] [NPCs] Made sure Rua initial position is set to home.
[*] [Skybox] Made the night sky darker.
[*] [Sound] Added missing sound when sabotaging lab equipment during Jasmine's quest.
[*] [Stations] Added a collider in Wayrest Scraps by the outhouse so you can't get pushed behind it and stuck when opening the door from specific spots.
[*] [Stations] Delivery boxes that activate when starting [spoiler]Going Once[/spoiler] spawn a bit later.
[*] [Stations] Fixed stamp machine colliders.
[*] [Stations] Moved the treasure chest in Miner's Roost so that the Player can access it.
[*] [Stations] Removed floating seat in Fendrix Farms.
[*] [Stations] Removed wind turbine and functionality from Fendrix Farms (leftovers from scrapped quest)
[*] [Stations] Updated the inspection text on the Silver Resource Point, so that it says "Silver" instead of "Aged Copper" when inspected.
[*] [Localization] Fixed the naming of Pavel and Pri's Box in Barrenpyre Fields.
[*] [Tools] The pressurized pickaxe visual and held position has been fixed to be its intended values.
[*] [Train interior] Fixed the door frame camera collider issue in the locomotive.
[*] [Traveling] Fixed the problem that npc never leave garbage while arriving at the station.
[*] [UI] [strike]Start menu UI doesn’t overlap with other menus anymore.[/strike] Disregard, had it happen again.
[*] [Quests] Made sure [spoiler]Rosalind[/spoiler] goes home to [spoiler]Rosalind's Carpentry[/spoiler] after [spoiler]Katja's FQ "Anniversary" is completed, and does not go back to Peteny.[/spoiler]
[*] [Quests] Made sure [spoiler]Rosalind[/spoiler] is at home during [spoiler]Nora’s Hope when the player is supposed to pick up armchairs.[/spoiler]
[*] [Quests] Message in a bottle failed to be received after [spoiler]fishing in Spiegelbreeze.[/spoiler] The bottle will now always be received as intended when [spoiler]fishing there.[/spoiler] 
[*] [Quests] Fixed [spoiler]Advertisement adventures posters[/spoiler] not sticking around and breaking occlusion culling.
[*] [Quests] Edited two quest entries in [spoiler]Nora's Hope[/spoiler] so that it's more clear that [spoiler]you first need to talk to Rosalind to get the Cosy Armchairs.[/spoiler] (Only adjusted in English so far)[*] [Quests] [spoiler]Katja[/spoiler] now only starts wanting to travel after [spoiler]doing her friendship quest[/spoiler].
[*] [Quests] [spoiler]Lizzie[/spoiler] now wants to travel again after [spoiler]her part of Nora's Hope[/spoiler] is completed, as long as [spoiler]Messy Messages[/spoiler] is also completed.
[*] [Quests] Location triggers for [spoiler]Timothy[/spoiler] no longer requires you both to stay in a certain location to allow you to speak about the next step in the quest.
[*] [Quests] [spoiler]Loretta will now accept the Lucky Lure even if she's not at the beach.[/spoiler]
[*] [Quests] [spoiler]Where The Grass is Greener[/spoiler] quest now completes.
[*] [Quest UI] Actually fixed so the completed quests won't show up as "New!" in the Journal if the Player hasn't looked before.
[*] [Wagon selection] Made the workshop handle miniature wagons in a non-destructive way, making it impossible to accidentally lose them.

[/list]
[h2]Known bugs[/h2]
[list]
[*] Luggage can spawn on rails.
[*] NPCs can stand up in their seat after arriving to a station.
[*] Possible issue with receiving the Globetrotter achievement.
[*] Standard seats revert back to default color scheme if the player exits the workshop after uncoupling that wagon.
[*] The leaky barrel for the [spoiler]Slippery Business[/spoiler] quest doesn’t spawn.
[*] The mop given out during [spoiler]Cleaning Day[/spoiler] can’t be taken to other areas of the station.
[*] Wallpaper in Hammerweld station can’t be picked up.
[/list]



Keep up the bug reports, it makes things easier for us when prioritizing what to work on.
/EmeraldPawn

notes.title: All aboard!! Locomoto is now out on Steam! 🎉
notes.content:
[b]We are so excited to tell you all that Locomoto is out on Steam![/b] 🚂 
Your support for the game has been amazing and we’re so happy to be on this train ride with such helpful and kind passengers. Thank you all so much for playing the demo, reporting bugs, giving us suggestions, and sharing your feedback. [i]Now...[/i]

[h3]⬇️ Grab a seat and watch our latest cozy trailer ⬇️[/h3]
[previewyoutube=JiR_MJAEnCA;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]⬇️ It’s time to hop on board the Locomoto train ⬇️ [/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2328650/Locomoto/

[h3]➡️ Join our community on Discord!! ⬅️[/h3]
Your feedback is key to shaping the future of Locomoto 🛠️ Let’s work together to make it the coziest and fun train adventure ever! Share your thoughts here on Steam or [url=https://discord.gg/VVZcztRe8U]hop into our Discord[/url] to chat with us  directly.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45339008/cb6ea3e1b648547ffe3d38939bdb8c4165af7573.png[/img]

[b]Q: Will the game be released on other platforms?[/b]
A: [i]It’s coming to [b]Nintendo Switch[/b] later this year! [/i]

[b]Q: Is the game singleplayer or multiplayer?[/b]
A: [i]The game is a singleplayer experience. However, we encourage you to share your trains and conductors with us and the community, we would love to see how you customize and decorate in Locomoto! [/i]

[b]Q: Will my Demo progress carry over to the full game?[/b]
A: [i]No, the demo is its own dedicated experience separate from the main game, it even has its own slightly different story. [/i]

[b]Q: My character is stuck, Is there a way I can continue playing without having to restart the game?[/b]
A: [i]This shortcut: [b]CTRL+ALT+U[/b] resets your character to a safe position. This should help in most situations whether you are stuck in dialogue, lost interaction input or physically somewhere in the world. [/i] 

[b]Q: Where can I find my back-up saves?[/b]
A: [i]The game autosaves every time you arrive at a station. If you run into a problem and need to revert back to an older savefile you can find it by going through the debug menu:
- Press § and navigate to “Saving”. 
- Your save should be called [b][SaveName](autosave[number])[/b], press the one you want to load.
 
❗Remember that any changes will be lost if you jump straight into these saves without saving your game first.[/i]

[b]Q: Where can I report a bug?[/b]
A: [i]Bugs are best reported through the bot in the Bug-Reports channel on the [url=https://discord.gg/VVZcztRe8U]Locomoto Discord[/url]. This will report it directly to our project management tool and make it easier for us to reach back to you when your bug has been fixed. 

Don’t have Discord? [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2328650/discussions/1/]Use the Bug Reports in our Steam Discussions![/url][/i]

[b]Q: I have a suggestion or idea to share with the devs, where can I do that?[/b]
A: [i]The absolute best way of reporting feedback and ideas is through the Feedback Channel on the [url=https://discord.gg/VVZcztRe8U]Locomoto Discord[/url]. Here, players can upvote and add to previously submitted ideas to let us know what’s popular and what you want to see in the game. This means we can get to a popular suggestion even faster!

Feedback can also be submitted through [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2328650/discussions/]Steam Discussions[/url]

[b]Q: Can I play the game on my SteamDeck?[/b]
A: [i]While it’s not officially SteamDeck verified yet, the game is playable on the SteamDeck. If you run into performance issues, try a lower resolution in the game’s options menu or set the graphics quality settings to low. [/i]

[b]Q: I am a Content Creator/Steam Curator/Streamer, how could I get a review copy of the game?[/b]
A: [i]You can reach out to us via email: [url=contact@greentiledigital.com][b]contact@greentiledigital.com[/b][/url] ✉️[/i]

[b]Q: Will there be paid DLCs or free updates coming in the future?[/b]
A: [i]We're full of ideas for more post-release content/stories that we would love to share with you someday, but our current focus is making sure the release goes well and fixing bugs you all report to us. We’ll let you know if that changes! [/i]

[b]Q: Where can I find updates or more information about the game?[/b]
A: [i]We'll keep you updated here on Steam, so make sure to follow us here for the latest news 🥰
We also encourage you to follow the game on our social media channels for news but also fun content and sometimes giveaways or contests. notes.title: Demo update 2 - Camera adjustments 🎦
notes.content:
I know you just got a patch in the beginning of the week - but here come another one!

One thing that we kind of urgently wanted to tackle since then was the issue where some expressed they experienced nausea during their playthroughs, so in an attempt to combat this we've done some pretty drastic camera changes. Please let us know what you think about this - if it helped, if you miss how the last camera worked or anything of the likes! 

 As you know we're still in full development of the main game, so we want to thank you a little bit extra for the patience you've shown when encountering these issues. Your feedback and bug reports has been soo helpful so far, thank you! You're awesome 😍
[h2]
Changes 🔧[/h2]
[h3]Camera[/h3]
[list]
[*] You now don't have to right click to move the camera - it follows your mouse movement automatically
[*] Auto rotation of the camera is now disabled by default to prevent nausea - please give it a feel and see if it helped!
[*] Added some camera settings:
[list]
[*] Option to invert horizontal and vertical axes for mouse and controller cameras
[*] Camera sensitivity
[*] Option to enable auto rotation of the camera
[/list][/list][h3]UI[/h3]
[list]
[*] Updated the pockets to visually show how much you can stack
[*] The travel map now shows stations that have recycle bins
[*] More UI translations has been added to the existing languages
[/list][h3]Delivery[/h3]
[list]
[*] Delivery parcels now show the name of the destination station (try saying that five times in a row) when you hold it
[/list][h3]Character customisation
[/h3]
[list]
[*] Adjusted where the eyes are looking so they represent how they look in game better 👀
[/list]
[h2]Known issues 🔍[/h2]
[list]
[*] Luggage and some objects have been known to spawn on the tracks
[*] Sound settings does not currently save when quitting game
[*] If name field is not selected with mouse and keyboard input, you will currently not be able to write your name
[*] You'll get a nose even though you exit character customisation without a nose
[*] When leaving a station with a suitcase in your inventory and then putting it down on a seat, that seat will forever be blocked 🫣
[/list]
